findingDetails.title: Record-detail listeners are bound through the global active document instead of the panel's owning document
findingDetails.evidence: Registration and cleanup use window.activeDocument and window, unlike the owned-menu path which derives event.view.document.
findingDetails.recommendation: Derive the document and window from host.ownerDocument/panel.ownerDocument and keep registration, cleanup, and focus in that realm.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Record-detail and owned-menu are in the configured source scope.

findingDetails.title: Mobile-sheet detection mixes an owner document with the global navigator
findingDetails.evidence: isMobileBottomSheet receives a document but reads maxTouchPoints from the global navigator.
findingDetails.recommendation: Read touch-point capability from the owner document's defaultView navigator or define the global realm as an explicit contract.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Popover positioning is in the configured source scope.
